editorial_review.method: Full second-reader review; SHA-256 matches public slug, title, category, summary, sections and checklist. Private evidence does not affect hash.

similarity.method: Jaccard similarity of three-word shingles, article paragraph prose only

test_scope.renderer: Unmodified production renderer executed for each actual query ID inside a temporary harness; URL updates paced 110ms to avoid synthetic navigation flooding.
test_scope.csp: Production script/style directives enforced by four temporary browser fixtures; no live Apache/CDN deployment.

limitations: Image controls deter native page save/drag actions; public images remain retrievable through screenshots or technical tools.
Chromium browser was tested; physical iPhone and Safari native long-press/double-tap behaviour were not tested.

The first 114-layout pass used the completed mobile changes with a partial article dataset. Final reader layouts, all 500 article renderings, catalogue coverage, and CSP were checked against final content.
Production script/style CSP was enforced in browser fixtures; Apache/CDN header processing was not emulated.
No authentication backend, DNS deployment, payment, or external message was performed.
Editorial review is not a certification of compliance with every national or international law.
